title: Filtered free resolution of a complex
statement: Let $A$ be a ring and let $M^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. There exists a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] $P^\bullet\to M^\bullet$ and an increasing filtration by subcomplexes $0=F_{-1}P^\bullet\subset F_0P^\bullet\subset F_1P^\bullet\subset\cdots\subset P^\bullet$ such that $P^\bullet=\bigcup_iF_iP^\bullet$, every inclusion $F_iP^\bullet\to F_{i+1}P^\bullet$ is termwise split, and each quotient $F_{i+1}P^\bullet/F_iP^\bullet$ is isomorphic as a complex to a direct sum of shifts $A[k]$.

source.place: Differential Graded Algebra, Lemma 15.60.9 (Tag 09KP), proof; the specialization to ordinary rings is used in More on Algebra, Remark 15.60.11 (Tag 09PB)

proof.text: Starting with $M_0^\bullet=M^\bullet$, apply [lem-pc-derived-free-complex-cover] to obtain a degreewise surjection $P_0^\bullet \to M_0^\bullet$ which is surjective on cocycles; let $M_1^\bullet$ be its kernel. Iterating gives exact sequences $0 \to M_{i+1}^\bullet \to P_i^\bullet \to M_i^\bullet \to 0$ and a resolution $\cdots \to P_1^\bullet \to P_0^\bullet \to M^\bullet \to 0$.

Totalize this resolution with $P^n=\bigoplus_{a+b=n}P_{-a}^b$ and differential $d(x)=f_{-a}(x)+(-1)^a d_{P_{-a}}(x)$ on $x\in P_{-a}^b$. The identity $d^2=0$ follows from $d^2=0$ on each $P_i$ and the relation $f_{i-1}f_i=0$, so $P^\bullet$ is a cochain complex, and the augmentation is induced by $P_0^\bullet \to M^\bullet$.

source.place: Differential Graded Algebra, Lemma 15.60.9 (Tag 09KP), construction of the total complex

proof.text: For each $i$, [lem-pc-derived-free-complex-cover] (applied to $M_i^\bullet$ in Step 1) provides a degreewise split short exact sequence of complexes $0 \to P_i'^\bullet \to P_i^\bullet \to P_i''^\bullet \to 0$ in which $P_i'^\bullet$ and $P_i''^\bullet$ are direct sums of shifts $A[k]$ with zero differential; in particular $d_{P_i}$ vanishes on $P_i'^\bullet$ and maps $P_i^\bullet$ into $P_i'^\bullet$. Set $F_{-1}P^\bullet=0$, $F_{2i}P^\bullet=\bigoplus_{j<i}P_j^\bullet\oplus P_i'^\bullet$ and $F_{2i+1}P^\bullet=\bigoplus_{j\le i}P_j^\bullet$ inside the total complex of Step 2. Each is a subcomplex: on $x\in P_i'$ the total differential is $f_i(x)\pm d_{P_i}(x)=f_i(x)\in P_{i-1}$, and on $x\in P_j$ it lies in $P_j\oplus P_{j-1}$. The quotient $F_{2i}P^\bullet/F_{2i-1}P^\bullet$ is $P_i'^\bullet$ with differential induced by $\pm d_{P_i}$, which is zero, and $F_{2i+1}P^\bullet/F_{2i}P^\bullet$ is $P_i''^\bullet$ with its zero differential; both are direct sums of shifts $A[k]$ as complexes. The degreewise splittings of $P_i'\subset P_i$ give termwise split inclusions $F_nP^\bullet\to F_{n+1}P^\bullet$, and every summand $P_i$ lies in $F_{2i+1}P^\bullet$, so the filtration is increasing and exhaustive.

source.place: Differential Graded Algebra, Lemma 15.60.9 (Tag 09KP), filtration construction

proof.text: The exactness of the resolution and the surjectivity on cocycles at every stage give the hypotheses of [lem-pc-derived-total-resolution-quasi-iso]. Therefore the augmentation $P^\bullet \to M^\bullet$ is a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: Differential Graded Algebra, Lemma 15.60.9 (Tag 09KP), final sentence invoking Homology, Lemma 09IZ

lean.statement: theorem exists_filtered_free_resolution {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) : ∃ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (q : P ⟶ M), QuasiIso q ∧ ∃ (F : ℕ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (ι : ∀ n, F n ⟶ P) (step : ∀ n, F n ⟶ F (n + 1)), IsZero (F 0) ∧ (∀ n, Mono (ι n)) ∧ (∀ n, step n ≫ ι (n + 1) = ι n) ∧ (∀ (k : ℤ) (x : P.X k), ∃ (n : ℕ) (y : (F n).X k), (ι n).f k y = x) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ), ∃ r : (F (n + 1)).X k ⟶ (F n).X k, (step n).f k ≫ r = 𝟙 ((F n).X k)) ∧ (∀ n, ∃ (I : Type u) (degree : I → ℤ), Nonempty (cokernel (step n) ≅ ∐ (fun i : I => (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (degree i)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))))

reviewed_lean.note: Ring->CommRing (Stacks convention, as merged sibling free-complex-cover), A implicit; M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat A) Z; q : P -> M QuasiIso; F : N -> complexes, F 0 zero (=F_-1), Mono iota, step compatible (increasing subcomplexes), termwise exhaustive, termwise retraction of step (split), cokernel(step n) iso coproduct of single A in degree(i) (zero differential, empty I allowed), no boundedness; docstring has the 4 proof steps; singleFunctor -> HomologicalComplex.single to match free-complex-cover, unused SingleFunctors import removed; no Mathlib/source match (FromJoel LeftResolution is a colimit resolution functor, not free filtered)
